text_en: When David was old and full of days, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
text_cn: 达味年老，寿数将满，遂立自己的儿子撒罗满为以色列王。

text_en: David assembled all the leaders of Israel and the priests and the Levites.
text_cn: 他召集了以色列所有的领袖、司祭和肋未人。

text_en: The Levites, thirty years old and upward, were counted, and the total was thirty-eight thousand.
text_cn: 肋未人自三十岁以上者，所有的男子都一一统计了，人数共计三万八千：

text_en: “Twenty-four thousand of these, ” David said, “shall have charge of the work in the house of the Lord , six thousand shall be officers and judges,
text_cn: 其中从事监督上主殿宇工作的有二万四千；长官和判官有六千；

text_en: four thousand gatekeepers, and four thousand shall offer praises to the Lord with the instruments that I have made for praise. ”
text_cn: 守卫的有四千；用达味所制的乐器赞颂上主的有四千。

text_en: And David organized them in divisions corresponding to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
text_cn: 达味按照肋未的儿子革尔雄、刻哈特和默辣黎，将他们编成班次：

text_en: The sons of Gershon were Ladan and Shimei.
text_cn: 属革尔雄的：有拉当和史米。

text_en: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.
text_cn: 拉当的子孙：为首的是耶希耳，其次是则堂和约厄耳，共三人。

text_en: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of families of Ladan.
text_cn: 史米的子孙：舍罗米特、哈齐耳和哈郎，共三人。这些都是拉当家族的族长。

text_en: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
text_cn: 史米的子孙：雅哈特、齐匝、耶乌士和贝黎雅。这四人都是史米的子孙，

text_en: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they were enrolled as a single family.
text_cn: 为首的是雅哈特，齐匝次之。耶乌士和贝黎雅子孙不多，所以算为一个家族，归为一班。

text_en: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
text_cn: 刻哈特的子孙：阿默兰、依兹哈尔、赫贝龙、和乌齐耳，共四人。

text_en: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart to consecrate the most holy things, so that he and his sons forever should make offerings before the Lord , and minister to him and pronounce blessings in his name forever;
text_cn: 阿默兰的儿子：亚郎和梅瑟。亚郎与其子孙应分别出来，受祝圣为至圣洁的人，直到永远；在天主面前焚香事奉他，以他的名为人祝福，直到永远。

text_en: but as for Moses the man of God, his sons were to be reckoned among the tribe of Levi.
text_cn: 至于天主的人梅瑟，他的子孙归于肋未支派。

text_en: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
text_cn: 梅瑟的儿子：革尔熊和厄里厄则尔。

text_en: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
text_cn: 革尔熊的子孙，为首的是叔巴耳。

text_en: The sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the chief; Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.
text_cn: 厄里厄则尔的子孙，为首的是勒哈彼雅。厄里厄则尔没有别的儿子，但勒哈彼雅儿子众多。

text_en: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.
text_cn: 依兹哈尔的子孙，为首的是舍罗米特。

text_en: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
text_cn: 赫贝龙的子孙：为首的是耶黎雅，次为阿玛黎雅，三为雅哈齐耳，四为雅刻默罕。

text_en: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief and Isshiah the second.
text_cn: 乌齐耳的子孙：为首的是米加，其次是依史雅。

text_en: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
text_cn: 默辣黎的子孙：玛赫里和慕史。玛赫里的子孙：厄肋阿匝尔和克士。

text_en: Eleazar died having no sons, but only daughters; their kindred, the sons of Kish, married them.
text_cn: 厄肋阿匝尔死了，没有儿子，只有女儿，因此克士的儿子，即她们的堂兄弟娶了她们为妻。

text_en: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
text_cn: 慕史的子孙：玛赫里、厄德尔和耶黎摩特，共三人。

text_en: These were the sons of Levi by their ancestral houses, the heads of families as they were enrolled according to the number of the names of the individuals from twenty years old and upward who were to do the work for the service of the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 这些人按他们的家族，都是肋未的子孙，都是二十岁以上，一一报名登记，在上主殿内担任职务的首领。

text_en: For David said, “The Lord , the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he resides in Jerusalem forever.
text_cn: 因为达味曾想：“上主以色列的天主既使自己的百姓获得安宁，自己又永远定居在耶路撒冷，

text_en: And so the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the things for its service”—
text_cn: 肋未人就无须再抬会幕及其中应用的一切器具。”

text_en: for according to the last words of David these were the number of the Levites from twenty years old and upward—
text_cn: 为此，按达味最后的吩咐，肋未子孙应由二十岁开始登记。

text_en: “but their duty shall be to assist the descendants of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord , having the care of the courts and the chambers, the cleansing of all that is holy, and any work for the service of the house of God;
text_cn: 他们的任务是在上主殿内供职，辅助亚郎的子孙，管理庭院及厢房，洗净所有的圣物，并担任天主圣殿中的各种工作。

text_en: to assist also with the rows of bread, the choice flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baked offering, the offering mixed with oil, and all measures of quantity or size.
text_cn: 又管理供饼，素祭细面，或用盘烤，或用油抹的无酵饼，以及各种度量衡；

text_en: And they shall stand every morning, thanking and praising the Lord , and likewise at evening,
text_cn: 每日早晚应前去称谢赞颂上主；

text_en: and whenever burnt offerings are offered to the Lord on sabbaths, new moons, and appointed festivals, according to the number required of them, regularly before the Lord .
text_cn: 每逢安息日、月朔（shuò）及节日，向上主献各种全燔祭时，应常按规定的数目到上主面前；

text_en: Thus they shall keep charge of the tent of meeting and the sanctuary, and shall attend the descendants of Aaron, their kindred, for the service of the house of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 应负责照顾会幕及圣所，并照顾他们在上主殿内供职的弟兄──亚郎的子孙。
